objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: pag-unawa sa bhwe.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: understanding bhwe.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magkaiba ang akreditasyon, BHWE approval at appointment.
sections.takeaway_en: Accreditation, BHWE approval and appointment are different.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang akreditasyon, edukasyon, qualifying service at satisfactory record.
sections.takeaway_en: Verify accreditation, education, qualifying service and a satisfactory record.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kabuuang serbisyo at qualifying accredited service ay hindi laging pareho.
sections.takeaway_en: Total service and qualifying accredited service are not always the same.

sections.takeaway_fil: Suriin ang ebidensiya at saklaw; huwag magpasya batay sa label lamang.
sections.takeaway_en: Check evidence and scope; do not decide from a label alone.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iugnay ang tanong sa record, kondisyon at tamang CSC office.
sections.takeaway_en: Connect the question to records, conditions and the proper CSC office.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipaliwanag ang kondisyon at ebidensiya, saka tiyakin sa CSC.
sections.takeaway_en: Explain conditions and evidence, then verify with CSC.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na paliwanag ni Demi para sa Card A na may walong total years at tatlong accredited years?
check.prompt_en: What is Demi’s best explanation for Card A with eight total years and three accredited years?

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang tatlong accredited years sa kabuuang walo, suriin ang edukasyon at lahat ng service conditions/evidence, at magtanong nang tiyak sa CSC; huwag mangako ng approval o trabaho.
options.en: Distinguish the three accredited years from the total eight, check education and all service conditions/evidence, and ask CSC a specific question; promise neither approval nor a job.

options.fil: Accredited na, kaya sapat na iyon para sa BHWE approval at garantisadong government appointment.
options.en: Accreditation is already enough for BHWE approval and a guaranteed government appointment.

options.fil: Bilangin ang lahat ng walong taon; automatic na kwalipikado ang may JO/COS label at puwede na sa anumang government post.
options.en: Count all eight years; a JO/COS label automatically qualifies the worker for any government post.

check.feedback_fil: Una: tama. Tatlong taon lamang ang inilalarawang nasa accredited status; hindi dapat idagdag ang pre-accreditation service. Kailangang suriin ang degree-related college education at lahat ng continuity, active/full-time, voluntary at satisfactory service conditions at ebidensiya. Tiyak na CSC verification ang susunod, hindi pangako ng approval o trabaho. Ikalawa: mali. Isa lamang sa mga pangkat ang accreditation; hindi nito pinapalitan ang education/service requirements, CSC application approval o hiwalay na appointment. Ikatlo: mali. Hindi binibilang ang pre-accreditation service. Maaaring kwalipikado pa rin ang JO/COS worker, ngunit hindi garantiya ang label. May first-level exceptions at iba pang position qualifications; hindi BHWE ang pahintulot sa anumang government post.
check.feedback_en: First: correct. Only three years are described under accredited status; pre-accreditation service cannot be added. Degree-related college education and all continuity, active/full-time, voluntary and satisfactory service conditions and evidence must be checked. Specific CSC verification comes next, not a promise of approval or a job. Second: incorrect. Accreditation is only one teaching group; it cannot replace education/service requirements, CSC application approval or a separate appointment. Third: incorrect. Pre-accreditation service is not counted. A JO/COS worker may still qualify, but the label is no guarantee. First-level exceptions and other position qualifications remain; BHWE does not qualify someone for every government post.
